items.label: Adjustable Backrest
items.value: The accent chair is equipped with an adjustable backrest that adapts to your different seating positions, allowing you to find the perfect angle for reading, reclining, or napping

items.label: Accent Chair with Ottoman
items.value: The matching ottoman is perfect for stretching out and relaxing. Use it as a footrest, extra seating, or even a stylish accent piece to complement the chair, making it a versatile addition to any room

items.label: Tufted Crafted Chair
items.value: The tufted craft design adds a touch of sophistication to your room, allowing it to blend seamlessly with any decor. The chair is wrapped in corded fabric for a luxurious touch and stylish look. Not only is it soft to the touch, it's also hard-wearing

items.label: Comfortable & Sturdy
items.value: The combination of thick upholstery and a sturdy frame make this chair durable. Soft cushion provides comfort, while the metal and solid wood frame construction provides stability and sturdiness. Accent Chair Dimension: 27.1"W x 27.1"D x 15.7"H, Ottoman Dimension: 25.6"W x 15.7"D

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: The wooden chair base and footrest base made of FSC-Certified wood. Comes with a detailed instruction manual and all necessary tools for quick and installation. Enjoy your new accent chair in just a few simple steps
